description: A link to the page where the person books a 30-minute call with number7even. Optionally pre-fills a time from check_availability and the check id, so the call starts from their configuration. The person confirms with their own email and consent; an assistant cannot book on their behalf.

check_id.description: Optional check id (s-… or i-…) the call is about

title: Link where the person books a call
